note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-24 against RFC 9568 Section 7.2 and Section 5.2.8 (rfc/full/rfc9568.txt): "The following operations MUST be performed when transmitting a VRRP packet: ... * Compute the VRRP checksum" (message-only for IPv4; prepended RFC 8200 Section 8.1 pseudo-header for IPv6). Verified changes since 4bbcaa15ca (1adbcc4337): backend_linux.go::openV6 added parentRxFD for unicast reception while keeping unix.SetsockoptInt(txFD, IPPROTO_IPV6, IPV6_CHECKSUM, 6) at line 241. All four tagged test entries are byte-identical: IPv4 message-only checksum (and rfc5798-compatible negative) are proven by TestTransmittedAdvertFilledFromInstanceState, TestEncodeGoldenV3IPv4, and TestSendAdvertFillsFieldsAndChecksum (#1/#2). However, the IPv6 checksum clause remains unproven by any tagged unit: the transport test uses fakeBackend with no IPv6 checksum assertion and the instance test calls FillChecksum itself in the test body, so removing IPV6_CHECKSUM from openV6 leaves every tagged unit green. Verdict remains weak.
